what: a sound-only decode of an MPEG-TS or MPEG-PS counted from the sound's own first sample instead of the file's start: a .ts whose sound starts 0.3 s after its picture put a beep at 0.021 s where the same take as MP4 gave 0.299 s, so sync.py, scenes.py and multicam.py measured their sound on a clock the file does not have, silencedetect reported every silence that far early (silence.py's cut levels, metadata.py --auto-chapters), waveform.py drew its stills that far off, and the 16 kHz WAV an ASR engine transcribes was cut from the sound's first sample, timing every cue 0.3 s early
escaped: #766 fixed the same FFmpeg behaviour for the picture (`decision.picture_seek` keeps -copyts with the file's own timestamps), and its sweep looked at the picture only. Every sound-only decode instead relied on `aresample=async=1:first_pts=0`, which pads a sound that starts late on the clock the demuxer hands it -- and without -copyts the demuxer rewrites an MPEG-TS/PS timeline to start at the earliest stream it reads, so the sound alone became the origin and there was nothing left to pad. MP4 and MKV state a start of 0 for the sound, which is why every test built its late sound as an MP4 and passed
mechanism: probe.sound_clock() is the one place that shifts a sound-only decode onto the file's clock (`asetpts=PTS-<start_time + start>/TB`), and every sound-only decode calls it with -copyts: probe.decode_pcm_mono (sync, scenes, multicam, cut's beat grid, loop, words), probe.detect_silences (silence.py's cut levels, metadata.py --auto-chapters), silence.py's cut-level decode, waveform.py's stills, caption.py's karaoke energy split and _common/asr.engine_wav. test_guards.TimeGuard.test_a_late_sounds_place_is_the_same_in_every_sound_only_read is the class guard: it remuxes a take whose sound starts 0.3 s late to .ts and fails when the first sample, the silences or sync.py --replace-audio's written sound differ from the .mp4's, so a sound-only read added later is caught too. test_analysis.AnalysisTests.test_a_late_sound_on_mpeg_ts_keeps_its_place_on_the_files_clock remuxes a take whose sound starts 0.3 s late to .ts (start_time 1.467) and holds its first sample and its silences to the MP4's
